race.comment: Tricky race with all but one lining up for the first time. The most impressive triallist leading into this is STELLAR AMI (11) from the Waterhouse/Bott camp. Has only been produced once and scored with ease at Warwick Farm. Clearly the one to beat if she brings that performance level to race day. Kris Lees would dearly love to win the race named in his late father's honour and he has a chance with first starter BRONZE LION (1) who took out a Gosford trial on 28 October. Draws the fence which always helps. Ciaron Maher's contingent is headed by LUCKY LAKOTA (10) who was runner-up in a Rosehill trial on 4 November. Should get every chance from gate three. Another Lees runner in INSIDE PERFECTION (9) finished 0.6 lengths behind stablemate BRONZE LION at her only trial. Should be thereabouts on that evidence. TOYTOWN (5) won a recent Hawkesbury trial and looks a decent type for the Widdup stable.
